plan.topics:
Optimization and Regularization in Deep Learning Challenges in training 
deep neural networks: Vanishing gradients, Exploding gradients, Overfitting. 
Optimization techniques: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), Momentum, Nesterov 
Accelerated Gradient, AdaGrad, RMSProp, Adam. 
Regularization techniques: L1 and L2 Regularization, Dropout, Early Stopping, Batch 
Normalization, Weight Initialization methods.

metadata.title: Deep Learning Optimization and Regularization Quiz
metadata.instructions: Select the best answer for each of the following multiple‑choice questions. Each question carries 5 marks.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of regularization in training deep neural networks?
questions.answer_key: To reduce overfitting by adding a penalty term to the loss function.

questions.question_text: Which statement correctly distinguishes L1 regularization from L2 regularization?
questions.answer_key: L1 adds the absolute value of weights to the loss, encouraging sparsity; L2 adds the squared value, encouraging small but non‑zero weights.

questions.question_text: A deep network shows high training accuracy but low validation accuracy, indicating overfitting. Which regularization technique is most appropriate to address this problem?
questions.answer_key: Early Stopping – it halts training before the model overfits the training data.

questions.question_text: Which optimizer adapts the learning rate for each parameter based on the accumulated sum of squared past gradients?
questions.answer_key: AdaGrad – it scales the learning rate by the inverse square root of the sum of squared gradients.

questions.question_text: During training of a very deep network, which technique helps alleviate vanishing gradients by normalizing the inputs of each layer?
questions.answer_key: Batch Normalization – it normalizes layer inputs, stabilizing gradients across layers.
